```{python}
#| echo: false

# Record the rows by running the algorithm, so the film strip is checked like the code.
def draw(ax, p):
    a = [2, 7, 11, 15]
    V.trace(ax, p, [
        dict(values=a, pointers=[(0, "lo", "indigo"), (3, "hi", "pink")], label="step 1"),
        dict(values=a, pointers=[(1, "lo", "indigo"), (2, "hi", "pink")], label="step 2"),
        dict(values=a, pointers=[(1, "lo", "green"), (1, "hi", "green")], label="step 3"),
    ], gap=2.6)
V.show(draw)
```

Optional film strip of the algorithm on the sample. Use it when the walk changes and the steps are easier to see than to read. Replace the placeholder pointers with states the real code produces, or delete the figure.
